statements.statement: The clinical indication note documents recurrent episodes of syncope and transient neurological deficits suggestive of transient cerebral ischemic attacks
Diagnosis codes R55 and G45.9 are listed for this case
Mobile cardiac telemetry CPT 93229 was ordered
The service was ordered to evaluate for underlying arrhythmias or conduction abnormalities that may be precipitating these syncopal events and cerebral hypoperfusion
The denial is based on reason code CO-197
The CO-197 denial concerns missing prior authorization
